newsitem.title: ITALY: Illegal immigrants shipwrecked off Italy.
newsitem.headline: Illegal immigrants shipwrecked off Italy.

text.p: A Turkish-registered ship carrying illegal immigrants ran aground off southern Italy on Thursday and around 220 people were detained after they jumped overboard and swam ashore, police and coastguards said.
Most of those caught, who were expected to be served with expulsion orders, were Iraqi Kurds, police said. Pakistanis and Indians had also been on board.

The immigrants, including several women and children, swam to shore when the ship, identified by coastguards as the Vakfikebir, got into trouble in rough seas just south of the city of Catanzaro on the heel of Italy.
Six of the immigrants required medical treatment, including a girl who broke her foot.
There was no sign of the crew when coastguards boarded the vessel, which had set out from a Turkish port on May 23.
Southern Italy's long coast is a magnet for illegal immigrants, many of whom then make their way into northern Europe.
More than 15,000 Albanians landed on the southern Adriatic coast in March in a flotilla of decrepit boats after armed unrest broke out in the Balkan state.
